interpretation: Research acquisition is bounded and resumable, not verified autonomous production scheduling.

timeout.enforcement: urllib per-socket/network timeout; no separately verified strict wall-clock deadline
timeout.production_gap: Require an overall deadline in the operational collector; research receipts retain actual elapsed time.

retry: Only one explicit confirmed transport-timeout retry was used. HTTP429/denial never automatically retried.

portability.verified_environment: Python3 and Node24 on managed Linux, separate code/bulk directories

reproduction: Exact normalized chunk hashes reproduce. New coverage generated_at changes the regenerated artifact manifest digest; it does not supersede the frozen original delivery pin.
